nodes.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Wait for merge-queue completion before verifying the landing**

On a base branch that requires a merge queue, this protected quota path reports an error immediately after successfully enqueueing the PR: `gh pr merge --help` states, “If required checks have passed, the pull request will be added to the merge queue,” but the YAML-equivalent command flow here queries once and requires the PR to already be landed. The queued PR therefore remains open at this instant, `_verified_remote_merge_sha` returns no merge SHA, and Step 15 fails even though GitHub may merge it later without post-merge completion or cleanup. Poll the exact-head PR until it lands or reaches a terminal failure, as the existing merge wrapper/CI flow does.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the reviewed base while polling the merge queue**

When another change lands on the base branch while this PR is queued, `baseRefOid` can advance, but this check accepts any well-formed SHA. The local-review receipt is bound to the earlier `identity["base_sha"]`, while the protected intent records only the base branch name, so the queue can land against a base/diff that the independent reviewer never approved. Preserve the admitted base OID in the intent and, while the PR is open, require subsequent observations to match it (or obtain fresh review authority); after landing, verify the merge commit against that stored base.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
